## About
L & P Plumbing is a residential and commercial plumbing company based on Canion St in Austin. We handle everything from a simple faucet replacement to full rough-in plumbing for new construction.
We work in Austin and the towns around it: Buda, Cedar Park, Georgetown, Hutto, Kyle, Lakeway, Liberty Hill, Pflugerville, Round Rock, San Marcos and Westlake.
We like to keep things simple. We explain what's going on, give you fair pricing with no hidden fees, and invoice after the job is done. In reviews, customers mention Alex, Ben, Zach and Braylen by name.

## Services
- Underslab plumbing: Inspection and repair of the piping beneath your concrete slab foundation, plus plumbing under the slab for new construction.
- Water heater replacement: Replacing outdated units or upgrading to a tankless system.
- Water pipeline repair: From a small pipe leak to a full line replacement, for homes and businesses around the Austin metro.
- Leak detection: We use professional tools to find hidden leaks before they cause more damage.
- Drain cleaning: Clogged or slow drains anywhere in your home or business, from the kitchen sink to the main sewer line.
- Sewer line repair: Cracked pipes, tree roots and repeat backups assessed and fixed for the long haul.
- Plumbing installation: Sinks, toilets, faucets and more, installed to fit and work right.
- Emergency plumbing: Burst pipes, sewer backups and overflowing fixtures, handled quickly to limit the damage.

## FAQ
Q: Do you take emergency calls?
A: Yes. Emergency service is available 24/7, day or night.

Q: What should I do first in a plumbing emergency?
A: Shut off your main water supply right away to limit the damage, then give our emergency plumbing team a call.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. We offer flexible in-house financing. Just ask about it when you book.

Q: Do you have a discount for veterans or seniors?
A: Yes. Active military, veterans and seniors get 10% off our plumbing services. It's limited to one client per household, has a maximum amount, can't be combined with other offers, and some restrictions may apply.

Q: When should I think about replacing my water heater?
A: Consider it if your water heater is over 10 years old, the hot water is inconsistent, it seems inefficient, or it keeps needing repairs.
